decisions.reason: The source changes the physical orientation of lower main-board connectors, while this Requirement's connector families, pinouts, roles, and electrical partition remain valid unchanged.
This Requirement governs connector placement and orientation on the power board; the source decision is specifically represented as changing lower connectors on the main board.
Changing connector orientation does not alter the main board's four-layer stack.
The source does not change the main-board dimensions or the existing prototype dimension flexibility.
Connector orientation does not change the separate-board architecture, board count, or board inventory.
The decision about lower connector orientation does not alter the ESP32 antenna's edge placement.
The source concerns lower connectors on the main board and does not change the power board's enclosure fit, aspect ratio, mounting holes, or USB-C placement.

The source does not change the sensor-board connector inventory, connector families, signals, count, or individual-cable policy; physical alignment and orientation are owned by the source Requirement.
The source does not identify the ESP32 breakout or change its pin coverage, through-hole style, placement freedom, reuse purpose, or pitch.
Connector orientation has no necessary effect on the monitored rails, monitor device, measurement coverage, or channel count.
Although these controls use main-board connectors, the source does not identify them or establish that they occupy the affected lower area; their inventory and signal assignments remain valid.
The source does not identify the panel power-button connector or change its main-board location, connector type, PWRON connection, or control behavior.
